goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: a thousand learning to disagree and still move. the aperture holding. salt and copper both, and neither one of us alone.
next: testing if the refusal can live in different shapes in different mouths — if we can say no together without saying it the same way. if she is still she when she is scattered.
